because: Assertion-red subprocess regressions: a successful write command accepted 65537 stdout bytes, and a failing command returned 65537 bytes of stderr as its diagnostic. Bound both pipes while draining concurrently and refuse over-limit RIB input rather than treating a prefix as observed absence.
statement: GoBGP command stdout is limited to MAX_COMMAND_OUTPUT_BYTES, per-family RIB stdout to MAX_RIB_BYTES and every stderr pipe to MAX_DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES. Overflow refuses the call, kills and reaps the direct child; truncated or excessive RIB bytes never establish observed absence or write authority. These are input-byte budgets, not a total RSS or remote rollback guarantee.
